name: Jukha
summary: Israeli card-passing game where players collect four of a kind to exit; last two left, one holding Joker, lose.
rules_text: Use 4 cards of each rank per player plus one Joker in total. Deal all cards clockwise so player left of dealer gets 5, others 4; keep hands hidden. Suits irrelevant. On a turn, if you have 4 cards and they are all equal, show them and exit and cannot lose. Otherwise you must request a card from the player who currently has 5 cards. You may name a rank you want. The 5-card player must offer one card face down and may claim any rank, truthfully or not. You may take it and end your turn with 5 cards, or reject it to ask for a second. If second offered, you must take one of the two offered and other returns. You may instead ask for a third; then you must take the third and both first return. After your turn you have 5 and are asked next. Having 4 of a kind plus extra does not let you exit; you need exactly 4 at start of your turn. Joker cannot exit. Play until only two players remain; they both lose.
rating_reason: Card-passing quartet elimination, last two lose, clear strategy
